o8.why: F3c shows rounded, lobed particles, partly clustered, on a textured underlying surface; the reader's 'blocky' and 'featureless background' overstate how angular the particles are.

prpr.why: The F7 rows are the 1/5/7.5/10 wt% ratios and the 2.5 wt% data is in F6d, which has no panel crop, so no citable panel shows the 2.5 wt% peak; it rests on the text.

o21.why: The day-0 red arcs read 1.6e8 (a), 2e9 (b), 1.2e9 (c) and 0.9e9 (d) as the node says. The reader took the day legend for the variable because the row-to-ratio mapping is caption-only, and that mapping is already listed in requires_unseen.

o22.why: In the F9 a1/b1 Bode plots the 15-30 d curves drop to log|Z| ~6 and the 40-60 d curves climb back to ~7-7.5, so the rebound is visible; the reader only described the Nyquist day-0 arc.
